business_problem: IndusInd Bank needed a better way to support real-time banking analytics, hyper-personalization, and AI-first decisioning because the legacy warehouse could not refresh, unify, or operationalize enterprise data fast enough for modern digital banking and regulatory workloads.
solution_summary: IndusInd Bank uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support real-time banking analytics, hyper-personalization, and AI-first decisioning. The implementation replaced a legacy state where the legacy warehouse could not refresh, unify, or operationalize enterprise data fast enough for modern digital banking and regulatory workloads. Banking transactions and customer interaction data move through Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog and Delta Sharing governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Agent Bricks, and Serverless compute operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver real-time reports and dashboards and hyper-personalized offers.
business_outcome: IndusInd Bank improved real-time banking analytics, hyper-personalization, and AI-first decisioning with measurable results including ~98%, Faster data insights delivery — from 30 hours to 45 minutes or less, and 1,200+ reports and dashboards supported, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: Faster data insights delivery — from 30 hours to 45 minutes or less
Months to complete enterprise-wide migration (originally scoped at 2.5 years)
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Automated ingestion and transformation pipelines keep source data synchronized for downstream analytics and AI.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: We want to be the AI-first bank. And given that requirement, our data lakehouse plays a major role in supporting real-time engagement and hyper-personalization for our customers,
We did not have a comprehensive data approach. Whenever business users were carrying out analytics, they used to miss out on certain parts of the data,
With our old warehouse, data ingestion took one or two days. We needed to bring the data into our lakehouse in near real time,
We are the only bank in India that uses a single data lakehouse on a single technology, which is Databricks,
